title: SKY RACER
oneLiner: Pilot a stunt plane through colorful courses, drift around clouds, grab gadgets, and beat rival flyers to the finish.
hook: Choose flight altitude to clear hazards and shortcut rings; time boosts and items to pass rivals.
ramp: Three courses introduce stronger winds and moving hazards, with three laps per race.
mechanics: Auto-forward airplane racing against three AI rivals. Left/right steer; up/down select one of three altitude bands.
A uses a collected gust boost, homing balloon or cloud puff. B boosts for 0.7 seconds with a default 2.7-second cooldown.
Clouds, storm balloons, winds and course boundaries impede flight. Three spin-outs cause a three-second checkpoint rescue.
Three laps per race; three races per cup. Results advance on A after 1.2 seconds or automatically after 6 seconds. Highest total cup points wins, ties included.
artDirection: 256x224 overhead/three-quarter scrolling view with the player plane about 24x16 pixels, a bold red-and-cream fuselage, blue canopy, swept wings, and a contrasting spinning propeller. Rival planes use distinct silhouettes and colors: yellow biplane, green jet, and purple seaplane. Show readable banking-left, banking-right, boost, hit-spin, and crash poses. Track lanes use saturated blue sky, cream cloud banks, green islands, red-and-white buoy gates, and dark navy hazard shadows; keep active hazards high-contrast and backgrounds quiet. Item crates are 10x10 pixel floating boxes with clear symbols. HUD reserves the top 12 pixels for lap, place, item, and race timer.

preserve: third-person kart-racing structure adapted to an overhead arcade race
multiple racers competing across scrolling courses
drifting, item pickups, shortcuts, laps, placement and race progression
bright characterful racers and readable track hazards
change: replace all cars and kart visuals with planes
make flying the primary movement fantasy, with altitude used for shortcuts and obstacle avoidance
keep the game single-player against computer-controlled rival planes

controls.left: Steer or bank left during flight
controls.right: Steer or bank right during flight
controls.up: Climb one flight lane; hold to remain high
controls.down: Descend one flight lane; hold to remain low
controls.a: Use the held item during active racing
controls.b: Trigger the short boost burst during active racing

lose: Finish the three-race cup below the best rival cup total. Crashes rescue at a checkpoint instead of ending the game.
scoring: 10 per checkpoint; 50 per clean shortcut; placement points 15/10/6/3 per race. Preserve these defaults.
